description: Search Picardo’s orderable Labcorp tests by test name, six-digit Labcorp code or topic word, for example "ferritin", "vitamin D" or "thyroid". Returns each test’s code for prepare_order_link, a short description, price, preparation and the panels that already order it for everyone.
name: search_lab_tests
